Migrate camellia system config pages (#38)

## Summary
- migrate `system/app`, `system/endpoint`, `system/oss`, and `system/settings` into `apps/camellia`
- add shared system-config request/storage helpers on top of `@bougainvillea/api-client`
- wire the new routes into console navigation and restore the settings child entry page

## Testing
- `pnpm run check:camellia`
- `curl` local build routes for `/system/app`, `/system/endpoint`, `/system/oss`, `/system/settings`, `/system/settings/server`

## Manual QA Plan
- Open `/system/app` and confirm the page loads, the create/edit dialog opens, and endpoint preference buttons render per app.
- Open `/system/endpoint`, choose an app scope, and confirm the create/edit dialog renders environment, URL, and metadata fields.
- Open `/system/oss`, choose a locale, and confirm the create/edit dialog renders provider, bucket, endpoint, and default-toggle fields.
- Open `/system/settings` and confirm the entry cards navigate to `/system/settings/server`, `/system/app`, `/system/endpoint`, and `/system/oss`.
- Open `/system/settings/server` and confirm override save/reset controls update the displayed resolved base URL.
